answer_1.quote: the model is trained to maximize the likelihood of response given the corresponding instruction

answer_2.quote: we utilize 3 commonly used automatic evaluation metrics, including (1) Pair-wise Comparison, (2) Open LLM Leaderboard and (3) Alpaca Eval.

answer_3.quote: the comparisons are performed by GPT4 on the WizardLM test set.

answer_4.quote: Then 3 human participants are given the task of comparing the responses generated by the comparing models with the criteria same as the previous pair-wise evaluation, i.e. Helpfulness, Relevance, Accuracy, and Level of Detail.
